note: Counted by hand from https://docs.aws.amazon.com/privateca/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html before the parser was written. The bullet list under "AWS Private CA API currently supports VPC endpoints in the following AWS Regions:" holds 29 Regions, all of which resolve. Deliberately excluded from the count: the four Considerations bullets above that list (they name no Region); the DNS format string {{region}} and its worked example "us-east-2 for the US East (Ohio) Region", which is an example of an endpoint name, not a coverage statement; and the link to the AWS Private CA Endpoints and Quotas page, which is a pointer, not a list. "VPC endpoints do not support cross-Region requests" names no Region, so it is not an exclusion.
